title: ChatGPT enters the world of accounting: new add-on links it to invoicing software and banks! 🧾
body: ChatGPT enters the world of accounting: new add-on links it to invoicing software and banks! 🧾

OpenAI launched yesterday the "ChatGPT for Accounting" add-on, a dedicated work mode for accountants that connects the assistant to accounting software. The add-on targets invoice processing, bank reconciliation, month-end reporting, data entry, and audit preparation, and works with eight partner programs including QuickBooks, Xero, and Oracle NetSuite.

Simply put: ChatGPT is no longer just a general assistant — it now has a "work mode" that understands the tools of a specific profession: it reads your invoices, reconciles bank transactions, and prepares the month-end report. But the golden rule still stands: no final accounting entry is applied without a human approving it.
Would you trust an AI assistant to prepare your company's accounts? 💼
